source.description: an address or a host name; left out, any source

destination.description: an address or a host name; a host name is resolved with DNS and its first IPv4 address is checked

protocol.description: tcp, udp, icmp or sctp; tcp when left out

router.description: its logical router when it has several

at.description: read the newest snapshot at or before this time; left out, the latest

detail.description: summary or full: how much of each result to return
